'''WED-15-ST68''' was a [[WED-15 Septoid Treadwell/Legends|WED-15 Septoid Treadwell]] that belonged to [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit's]] tribe. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Nebit tried to sell the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]].
